test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following has terminal decimal representation?
solution:
Concept used:

Terminating decimal means a decimal that can be expressed in a finite number of figures or for which all figures to the right of someplace are zero.

Calculation:

Given options are:

(2)/(7) ≈ 0.2857 (not continues)

(2)/(9) ≈ 0.2222 (continues)

(2)/(3) ≈ 0.6667 (continues)

(2)/(5) = 0.4

Hence, (2)/(5) has a terminating decimal representation. 

∴ (2)/(5) among the following has terminating decimal representation.
